turns.question: It's the end of 7 October 2026. How many customers who signed up in 2026 have never placed an order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers who have never placed an order; the closest metrics are Signups (signups: 20 customers signed up from 1 January to 7 October 2026), Active customers (customers_distinct, which counts only customers with a non-cancelled order, so it cannot stand in for 'ever ordered') and the Signup-to-first-order rate (signup_to_first_order_rate, first orders within 30 days of signup only). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
